ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels concentrated in the central and lower-median regions, contrasted against 35% mid-to-high intensity (mottled light gray/white) pixels on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous mass occupies the central 1/3rd of the fluke, extending from the peduncle to the notch. Lateral lobes exhibit high-contrast mottled patterns with lighter pixels punctuated by discrete dark circular clusters, particularly in the upper right quadrant (X: 70-90, Y: 10-40 range).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire superior boundary; maximum pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) are localized at the distal tips. Median sections of the trailing edge show lower-amplitude, undulating topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave trajectory originating from the median notch, transitioning into an upward convex curve toward the distal tips, resulting in a distinct 'butterfly' wing morphology.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density detection of roughly circular, dark-bordered rings (barnacle scars) localized on both lobes. The right lobe contains a high-contrast cluster of approximately 18 distinct rosettes; the left lobe displays a sparser cluster of 6 visible rosettes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent near-vertical white linear tracks (rake marks) are detected at the boundary of the dark central mass and the right lobe; additional faint horizontal abrasions are visible on the far-right distal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent healed vertical scar on the right-median fluke; extensive barnacle colonization scars (rosettes) creating a unique circular fingerprint across the lighter-pigmented distal surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'target' shaped scar (concentric ring) located mid-right lobe, characterized by a dark center surrounded by a high-intensity white halo.
